metadata.title: Implement Service Layer
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Implement business logic in the service layer following SOLID principles and clean architecture patterns. Use when creating managers, calculators, validators, or other service components.

output.description: Service component files with interfaces and implementations

specificActions: Parse Components List: Get component specifications from context parameters
Study Existing Patterns: Search for similar managers/calculators/validators in Service/ subdirectories
Create Service Interface: Define method signatures following discovered patterns
Create Service Implementation: Implement business logic with SOLID principles
Create Arguments/Results Models: Create in Contracts.Internal/ following naming patterns
Register in DI Container: Add service registration following existing patterns
bestPractices: Search for similar managers/calculators/validators before creating
Check naming conventions in existing services
Review how existing services interact with repositories
Review patterns for calling external APIs
Check event publishing patterns (if using publishers)
Note reusable helper classes in Service/Utils/

substeps.name: Parse Components and Study Patterns
substeps.description: Parse component specifications and find existing patterns
actions: Parse the components list from context parameters
For each component type, search for existing patterns
Document naming conventions and implementation patterns

substeps.name: Create Service Interface
actions: Create interface in appropriate Service/Managers/Interfaces/ folder
Define method signatures following discovered patterns

substeps.name: Create Service Implementation
substeps.description: Implement the service with business logic
actions: Implement business logic for each operation

substeps.name: Register in Dependency Injection
actions: Add service registration to DI container

substeps.name: Verify Implementation
substeps.description: Verify code compiles and follows patterns

flow.description: Parse components → Study patterns → For each: Create interface → Create implementation → Create models → Register in DI → Verify
